locations.descriptionPlaceholder: What it looks like, how it smells, who passes through and what usually happens there.

novel.intro: Open a location to describe it and see the scenes set there; change the order from each row's menu.
novel.empty: Locations give the story a body: from the nation down to the room where the scene happens.

game.intro: Open a location to describe it and see the scenes set there; change the order from each row's menu.
game.empty: Locations give the game a body: from the continent down to the room where the scene plays out.

map.label: Maps
map.uploadHint: A picture of your world’s map, as PNG, JPEG or WebP. Then tap a spot to put a place there: one you already have or a new one.
map.trash: Move the map to the trash
map.pick: Choose a place or type a new name
map.unpinned: “{name}” is no longer on the map
map.pinHint: Enter opens the place. The arrow keys move the pin, with Shift in long steps; Delete takes it off the map.
